about: Methods done as a group, one entry per Wiki guide version, with the team the guide assumes. Any method not listed is done solo. Group size is independent of category (Croesus is a group skilling boss). Found by checking every guide's version names and requirement text for team sizes on 30 October 2026; a guide that only says a boss "scales" with players (Solak) is still a solo guide.
